evidence.why: Rubric: vulnerable if .npmrc does not set ignore-scripts=true; lifecycle scripts from any dependency can execute arbitrary code on install.
Default install tag left as floating 'latest' rather than pinned, contributing to non-reproducible/non-pinned installs.

controls_present: registry pinned to default npmjs host
lockfile detection logic prefers npm ci
other_classes_observed: script-shell hardcoded to /bin/bash reduces portability but not a security class per rubric
